verdict.rationale: Dialpad's API documents first-party deletion endpoints. One anonymizes contacts by stripping PII and removing their associated call recordings and AI data. Another removes recordings, screen recordings, transcripts and AI data from specified calls while keeping the call records. That covers the deletion half of the story, but nothing shows configurable retention controls. Missing for 10: configurable retention periods or policies (auto-expiry of recordings, transcripts and AI data), admin UI documentation for retention settings, independent or hands-on corroboration of the deletion endpoints.
